speaker: sam_latchet
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare. They said it in the yard like a title. Have I got it right?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast heard it, Sam. It is not a title I gave thee. Say it if the room is saying it, and do not make a bow.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare, will your sweetness walk on at the third trumpet?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have me by heart in two days, Will. It took the gentleman of Cambridge a whole book.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I was first on the Queen's paper, sweet Master Shakespeare. First. Read it again. A margin's a small place to be praised in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is. I mean to be comfortable there.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Equally wronged.

speaker: margery_pell
text: There's a lawyer's clerk in the twopenny rooms asks which of you is the sweet one. I said the one that looks sour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then he has his answer, and he may keep it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Scrape it, Abel. I would rather the plot were clean than witty.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A stool for Sweet Master Shakespeare, he has the toothache. It is all that sugar.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Shall I fetch the stool?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou shalt not fetch a stool, Sam. My jaw is not a property, and neither is his joke.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Let him scrape. The name is not in the pasteboard. The name is in the room, and the room has paid for it.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can only say it, and I thought it was manners.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was manners, Sam. Keep the manners, and leave the pasteboard to Abel.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: A shilling. The boxes do not agree, and I am not going home while they do not.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Where.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: Between Pell's box and the stair. A hurried change, not a thief.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Not out of my hand on purpose. The stair was loud. I can swear to the hurry. I cannot swear to his eyes.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: On the line where the error was. Not at the foot. A note at the foot would make the afternoon look better than it was.

speaker: john_heminges
text: On the line, then.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put it where he says. I am not here to be flattered by a total.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Twelve days. And no fool in it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I heard you. He did not.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Twenty-nine, when the shilling is home. And this is yours, sweet Master Shakespeare, told out with a flourish, since a plain count would be a waste of a name.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty-nine. You may flourish. You may not rename the sum.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I am not renaming the sum. I am renaming the man it is paid to. Sweet Master Shakespeare. It will be daily now.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twenty-nine shillings the share. The shilling is found. The line is corrected.

speaker: humphrey_larkham
text: The boxes agree. I have nothing else to find.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Twenty-nine, then. I will swear to the hurry, and to nothing grander.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty-nine. I am taking the share. I am not taking a new ruling with it.
